resources.string: The session for this step is unavailable or cannot safely be reused. Start sign-in again manually. No automatic retry was made.
VK has temporarily limited sign-in. Wait until VK allows access again. Fenrir will not repeat requests automatically.
The sign-in step failed. Check your connection or the code before trying again. The diagnostic below contains no credentials.
VK returned an incomplete or unsupported sign-in response. Start again manually.
Enter the verification code requested by VK.
Complete the VK verification before continuing.
The connection failed during sign-in. Check the network before retrying manually. No automatic retry was made.
The sign-in server returned an HTTP error. Check the HTTP code in the safe diagnostic below. No automatic retry was made.
VK rejected this API request. Check the API code in the safe diagnostic below. This does not by itself indicate an invalid SID. No automatic retry was made.
VK rejected authentication of this request. Check the API or OAuth code in the safe diagnostic below. No automatic retry was made.
CAPTCHA answer received. Press Next or Sign in to submit it manually. No sign-in request was made automatically.
VK requires a CAPTCHA (API 14), but no usable challenge is available for this step. No blind retry was made. Cancel and start again manually when VK allows it.
